technology_name: Cost-Effective Tilapia Feed Using Cashew Nut Meal
institution: Kerala University of Fisheries and Ocean Studies (KUFOS)
problem_solved: High feed cost and dependence on fish meal in tilapia farming
description: This feed formulation replaces 50% of soybean meal with cashew nut meal in the diet of tilapia. Cashew nut meal is identified as a lower-cost alternative to fish meal and was found suitable at specific inclusion levels. The formulation also demonstrated favorable economic conversion characteristics, making it a potential feed option for tilapia culture.
applications:
Aquaculture feed manufacturing companies
Tilapia farming and freshwater aquaculture enterprises
Integrated fish farming and agri-aquaculture ventures
Fisheries cooperatives and farmer producer organizations (FPOs)
Government fisheries departments and aquaculture development programs
